contract: construct() -> three lists of edge colours, one per instance from bounded_degree_graph(n, d, seed) for (40,4,101), (60,5,102), (80,6,103) in the verifier; colours follow the sorted edge order. Each colour class must be an induced matching (no two edges share a vertex or are joined by an edge). Minimize the total number of colours used; the Erdős-Nešetřil conjecture predicts at most 5d^2/4 per instance (20 + 31 + 45).
notes: The score totals colours on three fixed graphs of maximum degree 4, 5 and 6; it measures a colouring method, not the conjecture. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; reciprocal sums are reported as floats. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
